test_title: PYST 65: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/603840bb0408978befd102d7a5b60d205276fde3852de06d852feefae05884ab.png] 

Logic followed here is: (First letter-cluster positional values) - 2 = (Second letter-cluster positional values).

**For**

1) MQ - KO :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/200128e1dab4886784e382916a798d8590ab05a94cca8c84ec3edcc49a7b42ea.png] 

2) KO - IM :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c5130b1e28be30bdc721cfa2170117cddcaa2db4e79ea348338bfa91a6e4416.png] 

3) PS - NR:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cea26cc0b804b18b3c4cd26055419ce5b75d2f914e1c0baf273531d8a37e4aa1.png] 

4) GK - EI :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3207af567eb391e46f2cffd798a284ac5fb837de2f942690b611b41c2a10660.png] 

 

Therefore, the letter-cluster pair **PS - NR** does not belong to the group as it subtracts 1 from the second letter instead of 2.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
